_comment: Shawnee County, Kansas. The reference county: every other county config copies
this shape and changes only the urls and the field names.
TWO SOURCES, because this county splits the record in two and most counties do.
The GIS layer is built for bulk (77,006 parcels, 5,000 a page, 16 requests for
the whole county) and carries owner + assessed values but NO year built. Year
built lives in the appraiser's Orion system, reachable through the public search
at ares.sncoapps.us, which answers one address at a time.
So: bulk loads the county, enrich fills year built per address on first touch and
keeps it forever. Enriching all 77,006 up front would be ~77,000 requests at a
small county for data almost none of which anyone will ever ask for.

enrich._comment: countyCode is the Kansas county NUMBER (089), not the FIPS code (20177). They are different and both are real; do not merge them.

_zip_comment: Shawnee County zip codes. Only used to break ties when two counties hold the same street name, so an incomplete list degrades to 'unranked match', never to 'no match'.
